## What to build

Setting `buck2.testCache.endpoint` to a remote REAPI address writes it into `[buck2_re_client]`. tk stops managing and probing a local server, and the runner records nothing while the endpoint isn't local, until shared-cache handover is decided (spec §7).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With a remote endpoint set, no local server is started or probed
- [ ] Hits served by the remote endpoint are reported as `recorded, remote`
- [ ] The runner writes nothing to a non-local endpoint

- turnkey-vnm.25
